limitations: The Qwen manifest is a source/registration closure for the text-only model path, not an AMD execution result; every contract remains unpassed until it runs through GemSim with a differential oracle.

The Triton result uses a temporary patched probe overlay and reaches TTIR/TTGIR/LLIR/AMDGCN/HSACO only. Its CMake graph still retains NVIDIA plugin sources, it is not a committed launcher, and no device or simulator instruction executed.

CP17-A maps one locked zero-relocation gpuReadWrite image in a fixture-scoped, image-relative host context. It does not enforce segment permissions, apply relocations, construct dynamic kernarg/AQL, submit a queue, or connect the GPU pipeline.
The CP17 journal is still in prepare until root staging, coordinator commit, and finalize. Full ROCm/OpenCL CTS is deliberately not a prerequisite for the Qwen-specific gate.
result: The accepted CP17-A staging and static Qwen/Triton preparation evidence are reproducible; the next gate remains native translation plus dynamic AQL/kernarg and one real pinned GPU-pipeline differential.
